issues.description: Double-negated condition is awkward and could be expressed more clearly
issues.detail: The expression `!(nodeName === 'layer' && typeof node.nodes === 'undefined')` is correct but reads as a double negative inside an already-compound boolean. A clearer form like `(nodeName !== 'layer' || node.nodes !== undefined)` or extracting an `isLayerStatement` helper would improve readability without changing behavior.

issues.description: Missing explicit accept test for statement-form `@layer foo;` before `@import`
issues.detail: The PR adds a reject case for block-form `@layer foo {}` before `@import` but does not pair it with an explicit accept case for statement-form `@layer foo;` before `@import`. Adding that test would lock in the intended narrowing and prevent silent regression of the spec-compliant carve-out.

issues.description: Prefer idiomatic nullish or `Array.isArray` check over `typeof === 'undefined'`
issues.detail: PostCSS sets `nodes` to an array when a block exists and leaves it undefined otherwise. `!node.nodes`, `node.nodes == null`, or `Array.isArray(node.nodes)` is more idiomatic to this codebase and more robust to representation changes than `typeof node.nodes === 'undefined'`.

issues.description: Missing tests for anonymous and nested `@layer` block edge cases
issues.detail: The new check treats any `@layer` with a defined `nodes` array as block-form. Anonymous `@layer {}` and nested patterns like `@layer outer { @layer inner {} }` followed by `@import` should also trigger the rule. A small test or two would document and lock in this boundary behavior.

synthesis.summary: The panel unanimously agrees this is a small, correct, well-scoped bug fix that distinguishes statement-form `@layer foo;` (allowed before `@import` per the CSS Cascade Layers spec) from block-form `@layer foo {}` (which invalidates a following `@import`). The implementation, test, and changeset are sound with no correctness or security concerns. Consensus feedback is cosmetic: clarify the double-negated condition, prefer a more idiomatic presence check than `typeof === 'undefined'`, and add an explicit accept test for statement-form plus coverage for anonymous and nested layer blocks. Safe to merge after minor polish.
